Selected for the show

The show

Star Rays and Star Jewellery are showing one book in Hong Kong in 2026. Star Rays is a De Beers sightholder and supplies natural diamonds only. Star Jewellery designs and sets every piece at its benches in Surat, and supplies the lab-grown versions itself. The two remain separate companies — this is a collaboration on one catalogue, not a merger. Nothing here is a concept piece; every reference has a quotation behind it and can be ordered in any of the four configurations.

Both metals, made

The 14 and 18 karat versions are separate builds, not a conversion. The gross and net weights shown against each karat come from that karat's own quotation.

Two diamonds, one stone plan

Both versions carry the same shapes, sizes and counts. The natural stones come from Star Rays; the lab-grown are supplied by Star Jewellery. Star Rays does not deal in lab-grown diamonds.

Order sizes

Ring sizes and necklace lengths are listed per piece where the quotation records them. Anything not listed is made to order.

Prices

US dollars, per piece, ex-works. Gold and diamond rates move; confirm on the day of order.

Ask for a piece

Send the reference and the configuration you want. We will come back with availability, lead time and the confirmed price.

Home

Star Rays × Star Jewellery

Two houses, one book. Star Rays is a De Beers sightholder: it cuts, grades and supplies natural diamonds, and natural diamonds only. Star Jewellery, on Varachha Road in Surat, designs and sets every piece shown here, and supplies the lab-grown versions on its own account. The two are separate companies; Hong Kong 2026 is a collaboration between them, shown as a single register of 107 references.

Everything in the book is quoted in four configurations. That is not a finishing option: the 14 and 18 karat pieces are separately costed builds with their own gross and net gold weights, and the natural and lab-grown versions are separately priced against the same stone plan. Choosing a configuration in the bar at the foot of the page changes every price and every gold weight in the catalogue at once.

Who supplies which diamond

Natural: Star Rays, as a De Beers sightholder. Lab-grown: Star Jewellery. Nothing lab-grown in this book is sourced through Star Rays.

Where the numbers come from

Gold weights, stone counts, shapes, sizes and clarity grades are read from the workshop quotations for this book. Prices are read from the master price list. Nothing here is estimated.

What is not listed

Where a quotation records no ring size or necklace length, none is shown. Colour-stone species are given by the workshop's own stone code rather than named.

Ordering

Quote the catalogue number or the reference code, the karat and the diamond type. Mixed orders across configurations are fine.
